summary_1line: Vyasa explains the hierarchy of senses, mind, intellect, and soul, teaching yogic self-realization and the disciplined conditions required to receive this highest spiritual knowledge.

image_candidates.scene_text: A yogin sits motionless like a steady lamp in windless air, eyes closed, as faint radiance suggests the inner vision of the Supreme Soul within all beings.
A cosmic wheel of Time with twelve spokes and six seasonal hubs devours the universe as stars and creatures spiral toward its vast open mouth.
A charioteer guides powerful horses along a winding path, symbolizing the soul directing the senses with the mind as the sixth rein.
